text:
marta: Heads-up — I'm experimenting with coalescing smokehouse runs for the new model intake. Want to discuss tradeoffs: run fewer broad checks vs per-model deep checks.
ben: Do you mean batching multiple model configs into one smoke job?
chao: yeah, e.g. group by architecture & quantization level, run a shared perf+sanity sweep. saves GPU time but could hide per-model quirks.
lucas: main risk is tail latency surprises. Coalesced runs can average out spikes. We need an acceptance window, not just mean/median.
anika: also consider golden-input coverage. If we only run a shared smoke, some edge-case prompts may never hit the model variant. sampling matters.
marta: draft idea: 1) coalesce by binary signature (arch+quant+tokenizer hash), 2) run a lightweight perf sweep (p95/p99 + regressions), 3) for new forks run per-model deep smoke for first N commits.
ben: sounds reasonable. How do we pick the golden set per-architecture though?
chao: heuristic: union of top failure prompts from previous 30 days + a stratified sample by seq_len buckets. cheap to compute.
lucas: we should also attach an SLO for smoke runs: e.g. max allowed p99 latency increase <= 10% and quality regression <= x% on key evals. If fail, route to deep smoke.
anika: +1 on routing. also keep a small per-model shard (1%) of real traffic for canary to detect runtime-only issues.
marta: config sketch (proposal):
```
smoke_policy:
  coalesce_by: [arch, quant, tok_hash]
  light_sweep: {seeds: 100, metrics: [p50,p95,p99,token_throughput]}
  deep_sweep: {enabled_for_new_models: true, commits_threshold: 3}
  canary_fraction: 0.01
  golden_selection: {window_days: 30, stratify_by: [seqlen, prompt_type]}
```
ben: Nice. What about flakiness? Our perf noise on shared infra can cause false positives. Need retry/backoff and historical smoothing.
chao: agree. Use rolling median + anomaly detector (z-score or tukey) over last K runs before failing.
lucas: also, capture KV-cache cold/warm variants in the sweep. Cold-starts often blow p99.
anika: for plugin adapters (runtime shims) we need a light contract: surface `signature`, `tokenizer_hash`, `runtime_flags`, and a `smoke_hint` for special prompts. example:
```
adapter_contract:
  signature: str
  tokenizer_hash: str
  runtime_flags: [string]
  smoke_hint: {must_run_prompt_ids: [int]}
```
marta: good call. That lets coalescer make better decisions without deep model introspection.
ci-bot: scheduled: smoke-coalesce-job/6212345680 queued by marta. estimated run time: 45m.
ben: I'll take the prototype wiring for the coalescer and a naive golden selector.
chao: I'll add anomaly smoothing and cold/warm sweep variants.
lucas: I'll draft SLO language for the smoke gate and rollback policy.
anika: I'll write the adapter_contract doc and a tiny shim for existing converters.
marta: awesome — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT. posting a short RFC follow-up in the repo. :thumbsup:
ben: :+1:
chao: :raised_hands:
lucas: see you then.
